label: sdc02_0220_dragonbb_01
text: Look at you, buddy! Way to go![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0220_dragonbb_02
text: Guess we got a new BB League Champion![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0220_dragonbb_03
text: The academy’s got a prize for people like you\nwho make it all the way to being Champion.\r\nHere—all yours.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0220_dragonbb_04
text: Hey. Kieran.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0220_dragonbb_05
text: This may not mean much coming from a guy who\ncouldn’t beat you, but...[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0220_dragonbb_06
text: I wish you’d go back to having fun with all this.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0220_dragonbb_07
text: I get that burning desire to win. I mean, who\ndoesn’t like winning?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0220_dragonbb_08
text: Just...don’t let that desire burn you to a crisp.\nIt’s hard to watch.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0220_dragonbb_09
text: C’mon. Let’s all go and—[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0220_brother_01
text: *mumble mumble*\n...win...next time...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0220_dragonbb_10
text: Come again?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0220_brother_02
text: I won’t lose... Next time, for sure, I’ll...I’ll win.\nNext time...I’ll win...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

text:

that it does, well...complicate matters.\c

we ought to proceed...[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
